hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Prefect API base URL. Use https://api.prefect.cloud for Prefect Cloud, or your self-hosted server's URL, e.g. http://localhost:4200.

authType.title: Authentication
authType.description: Choose between Prefect Cloud or a self-hosted Prefect Server.

apiKey.title: Prefect API Key
apiKey.description: Prefect Cloud API key for authentication.

accountId.title: Account ID
accountId.description: Prefect Cloud Account ID. Found in the URL: app.prefect.cloud/account/{accountId}.

workspaceId.title: Workspace ID
workspaceId.description: Prefect Cloud Workspace ID. Found in the URL after /workspaces/{workspaceId}.

oneOf.title: Prefect Server
oneOf.description: Authentication configuration for a self-hosted Prefect Server. Leave Basic Auth String empty if the server has no auth enabled.

authString.title: Basic Auth String
authString.description: Self-hosted Prefect Server Basic Auth credential (PREFECT_SERVER_API_AUTH_STRING), format 'user:password'. Leave empty if the server has no auth enabled.

numberOfStatus.title: Number of Status
numberOfStatus.description: Number of past flow run statuses to ingest per flow.

verifySSL.title: Verify SSL
verifySSL.description: Client SSL verification. Make sure to configure the SSLConfig if enabled.

sslConfig.title: SSL Configuration
sslConfig.description: SSL Configuration for Prefect API connection.

oneOf.title: Validate SSL Client Config
oneOf.description: OpenMetadata Client configured to validate SSL certificates.

caCertificate.title: CA Certificate
caCertificate.description: The CA certificate used for SSL validation.

sslCertificate.title: SSL Certificate
sslCertificate.description: The SSL certificate used for client authentication.

sslKey.title: SSL Key
sslKey.description: The private key associated with the SSL certificate.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.
